sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced across all key metrics: full-year revenue guidance lowered to flat to down 1% (from prior expectations), Q2 EPS guided to $1.76-$1.81 versus $3.10 a year ago, and operating margin guided down 380 basis points for the full year. Management explicitly cited negative brand commentary, underperforming product launches, and tariff headwinds as ongoing structural risks. The guidance cuts are material and organic, not attributed to one-time items.

summary.revenue: Net revenue $2.5 billion, up 4% (2% constant currency). North America revenue decreased 3% (comparable sales down 6%). China Mainland revenue increased 30% (23% constant currency). Rest of World revenue increased 13% (9% constant currency).
summary.eps: Diluted EPS $1.69 compared to $2.60 prior year.
summary.guidance: Q2 revenue $2.45B-$2.475B (decline 2%-3%), Q2 EPS $1.76-$1.81. Full-year revenue $11B-$11.15B (flat to down 1%), full-year EPS $10.95-$11.15. Full-year operating margin expected to decrease 380 basis points to approximately 11.6%.
summary.margin: Gross margin 54.2% (down 410 bps). Q2 gross margin guided down ~410 bps. Full-year gross margin expected to decrease 90 bps.
key_risks: Negative brand commentary in media and social channels impacting traffic and top line
Underperformance of certain product launches (e.g., Look of Yoga campaign)
Tariff headwinds: 280 bps negative impact in Q1, 150 bps expected in Q2, 30 bps for full year
Fixed cost deleverage from store investments and distribution network
Higher markdowns in Q2 (up 50 bps) due to slower top-line trends
Proxy contest costs and layering back of expenses (store labor, incentive comp)
Disruption in Middle East franchise business due to conflict in Iran
Softer tourism in Europe and Japan
key_opportunities: China Mainland growth: Q1 revenue up 30%, full-year expected ~20% growth
Rest of World growth: Q1 revenue up 13%, full-year mid-teens growth expected
Product innovation: newness penetration targeted to rise to 35% of assortment from 23%
Chase program: 20% more volume chased this year to improve inventory responsiveness
Reduced product lead time from 18-24 months to 15-16 months, targeting 12-14 months
Enterprise efficiency initiatives: supply chain optimization, procurement, AI-powered systems
Increased marketing and community activations (SeaWheeze, Great Wall yoga event)
Store experience enhancements: 15% fewer SKUs, improved merchandising, reduced markdowns

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management acknowledged 'a few headwinds and a moderating sales trend' and lowered guidance across all metrics, while emphasizing actions to 'rebuild momentum' — the tone is measured and defensive rather than confident.
